complexity_ledger.narrative: MF-032 gives run() to the remaining adapters MF-028 banded runnable and fixes the runner's all-or-nothing comparison. FOUR adapters now execute generated cases end to end: InstallLocalCli (trivial), ScaffoldWorkflow, RecordBudgets and OpenTicket (moderate). Each run() composes the shared before-state builder + projector + field comparator -- promoted from production_adapters.py into the dedicated MODULE adapter_case_runtime.py (a module, NOT a base class: the adapters' apply() signatures are incompatible, so inheritance would fight them). apply() is retained untouched as the spec-unit surface; run() is additive. All four execute REAL reduced-corpus cases through the real runner (results/case-execution-run.txt) with 10 checked / 1 unchecked (result.next) / 0 mismatch, and each carries a NEGATIVE CONTROL proven to fail on the real case (results/case-execution-projection.txt): the corrupted after-state disagrees because the value is derived from the transition and observed from the filesystem, never read out of the field checked. The runner's whole-dict `==` (runtime.assert_case_result / assert_projected_state) is replaced by per-field comparison honoring UNCHECKED in run_generated_case_adapters.py (compare_fields_honoring_unchecked, assert_case_result_per_field), with new repo tests. HONEST executability re-measurement (reduced single-ticket corpus; full MC.cfg is intractable to load -- MF-034's surface): before-state materializability is unchanged at 81.6% (MF-031's axis, which this ticket does not touch); TRUE end-to-end executability, which additionally requires the case's action to HAVE a run(), is 7.8% -> 9.8% (+1221 cases: OpenTicket 699 + ScaffoldWorkflow 520 + RecordBudgets 1 + InstallLocalCli 1). The remaining 89.2% is dominated by the HARD/BLOCKED bands: RunEffectConformance, RunKillTest, RunSpecUnitTests, AnalyzeCorpus, AnalyzeComplexity and CloseTicket -- gate/oracle actions whose after-state changes nondeterministic gate variables not recoverable from the filesystem, plus the three CloseTicket-collision multi-close batteries. These stay apply()-only for structural reasons, reported not skipped (results/mf032-report.md). Zero TLA+ model delta; validation matrix green (TLC 231,621/depth 25, spec-unit 60, 512 repo units, specWorkflow 8/8 + cliWorkflow 2/2).

summary: Give run() to InstallLocalCli, ScaffoldWorkflow, RecordBudgets, OpenTicket (4 adapters now execute cases); promote the shared before-state builder/projector as module adapter_case_runtime.py (not a base class); fix the runner all-or-nothing == to per-field honoring UNCHECKED. Remaining adapters stay apply()-only for structural reasons (reported). Executability 7.8%->9.8% (both axes), re-measured. Zero TLA+ delta.

assertions: the shared before-state builder and projector are a module reused by every case-executing adapter, not duplicated.
apply() is retained as the spec-unit surface; run() is additive.
the runner all-or-nothing == comparison is replaced by per-field comparison with UNCHECKED honored.
each adapter that gains run() has a negative control proving its check can fail; MF-029 showed a check that cannot fail is the structural hazard here.
adapters that remain blocked are reported with the structural reason, not silently skipped.

ticket.objective: MF-028 banded the remaining fifteen adapters: 2 trivial, 4 moderate, 5 hard, 4 blocked. Its measured ~29 adapter-specific lines over ~145 shared holds for 2 adapters, roughly for 4, and NOT for the hard or blocked ones where the obstruction is structural -- extrapolating it would predict a small uniform task and be wrong. Promote the shared before-state builder and projector as a MODULE, not a base class (the apply() signatures are incompatible). Keep apply() as the spec-unit test surface and add a separate narrower run() for the battery adapters; rewriting them would destroy the epic accumulated defect knowledge. Also fix the runner all-or-nothing == comparison once, centrally.
